# geocode value

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:geocodeValue`](gmeow-geocodeValue.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/geocodeValue>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The string value of a geocode in its reference frame — the canonical literal carrier. Per-system properties ([`plusCode`](gmeow-plusCode.md), what3words, …) are convenience accessors; a single [`Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md) instance carries exactly one code value (enforced by SHACL).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal); functional

Use [`gmeow:geocodeValue`](gmeow-geocodeValue.md) from [`gmeow:Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md) to [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the canonical string value of a geocode in its frame; functional, the literal carrier behind the per-system accessors.

### Avoid when

- Avoid putting several distinct codes on one [`Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md) (it carries exactly one value, by SHACL).

### How to use

- Set one [`gmeow:geocodeValue`](gmeow-geocodeValue.md), or a per-system accessor ([`gmeow:plusCode`](gmeow-plusCode.md), [`gmeow:geohash`](gmeow-geohash.md), …) which it backs.

### Examples

- ex:plusLoc [`gmeow:geocodeValue`](gmeow-geocodeValue.md) "9F4W9C8C+W4".
